## Summary

LCFC (Hefei) Electronics Technology describes itself as Lenovo's
largest PC R&D and manufacturing base, in Hefei with R&D centres in
Taipei, Kunshan and Shenzhen, making personal computers, servers and
smart devices; it claims nearly 2,500 technical staff, more than 300 million
units shipped, and one in every eight laptops sold worldwide [1]. It is the joint-venture notebook maker Lenovo and Compal established in
2011 [4]; the venture was announced on 27 September 2011 to build
laptops and all-in-one desktops in Hefei, with Lenovo holding 51
percent [3], and in 2017 Compal was negotiating to sell its 49 percent
stake to Lenovo [4]. The IEEE registry lists 30 MA-L blocks to
"LCFC(Hefei) Electronics Technology co., ltd", at Yungu Road and Cui Wei
Road in Hefei, Anhui [2].

A MAC in an LCFC block is therefore most likely the network interface
of a Lenovo notebook or desktop built in Hefei, sold under the Lenovo
brand rather than LCFC's own [1][3]. The Wi-Fi cards fitted and their
chipsets vary by model and are not documented by the sources
consulted, so radios and silicon are not listed. Randomization depends
on the host operating system and is unknown here. FCC grantee codes are
not listed: the FCC ID databases refused the session that wrote this
entry, and nothing is filled in from memory.
